tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (5.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Heritage, warmth, American tradition. Used as background on `header`; text on `.page-title`, `.stat-value`, `.form-title`. 6.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Trust, stability, timelessness. Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-title`, `.form-label`. 11.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Weathered charm, nostalgia. Used as text on `.footer-links a:hover`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Aged paper, vintage warmth. Used as text on `header`, `.logo`, `nav a`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-wood
tokens.usage: Natural, rustic. Used as text on `.footer-bottom`. 3.9:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-dark
tokens.usage: Grounding, earthiness. Used as text on `body`, `.button-tertiary`, `.form-input, .form-select, .form-textarea`; background on `footer`. 13.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change`. 4.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Heritage, warmth, American tradition. Used as shadow/glow on `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`; background on `tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: button-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `header`, `.button-primary:hover`.

styles.name: display
